Name: PLAY_AREA_CREATE_PARAM_ST
Description: Shrinking-circle play areas: grid position, the event flags set when an area is chosen for Day 1 or Day 2, modifier conditions and boss placement.

Fields.Name: Disable Param - Network Test
Fields.Description: Standard row header flag: set rows are left out of the network test build. Appears unused by the game. Retail: set on every row.

Fields.Name: Map ID: AA
Fields.Description: Map area of the play-area centre (with Map ID BB/CC and Placement Position X/Z). Copied with the row into the play-area state; retail 60.

Fields.Name: Map ID: BB
Fields.Description: Map grid X of the play-area centre (see Map ID: AA).

Fields.Name: Map ID: CC
Fields.Description: Map grid Z of the play-area centre (see Map ID: AA).

Fields.Name: Force First Circle Placement
Fields.Description: Set: the circle placement for this play area accepts its first candidate position without retrying, even when it fails the checks (map edge margin, max shrink speed). Clear: up to 60 candidates are tried. Retail: set on 13 of 41 rows (Rotted Woods, Mountaintop, Crater, Noklateo, a Great Hollow row and the Divine Tower).

Fields.Name: Placement Position: X
Fields.Description: X position in metres inside the map tile given by Map ID, for the play-area centre.

Fields.Name: Placement Position: Z
Fields.Description: Z position in metres inside the map tile given by Map ID, for the play-area centre.

Fields.Name: Day 1 Selected Event Flag
Fields.Description: Event flag set ON when the expedition starts and this play area is the Day 1 area. 0: none. Retail 7650-7672.

Fields.Name: Day 2 Selected Event Flag
Fields.Description: Event flag set ON when the expedition starts and this play area is the Day 2 area. 0: none. Retail 7675-7697.

Fields.Name: Required Modifier: 1
Fields.Description: No game reader found (offline pattern lottery input). Retail: the Shifting Earth modifier the area needs (11 Mountaintop, 12 Crater, 13 Rotted Woods, 14 Great Hollow, 15 Noklateo), 0 on the standard areas.

Fields.Name: Excluded Modifier: 1
Fields.Description: No game reader found (offline pattern lottery input). Retail: a Shifting Earth modifier (11-15) under which the standard area is not used; 13000/13002 on two Great Hollow rows.

Fields.Name: Excluded Modifier: 2
Fields.Description: No game reader found. Retail: 12 on two rows, 13001 on one Great Hollow row, 0 elsewhere.

Fields.Name: Night Boss Attach Point
Fields.Description: SmallBaseAndSpotAttachPoint row where the night boss is placed when this is the Day 1 area.

Fields.Name: Connect Collision Entity ID
Fields.Description: Entity ID of a collision, stored in the map pattern when this is the Day 2 area; its later use was not traced. Retail: a collision in the area's own tile (e.g. 1042364800).

Fields.Name: Required Modifier: 2
Fields.Description: No game reader found. Retail: equal to Required Modifier: 1 on the Shifting Earth and Divine Tower rows, 0 elsewhere.

Fields.Name: Unknown
Fields.Description: Appears unused by the game. Retail 0 on every row.

Fields.Name: Unknown
Fields.Description: Appears unused by the game. Retail 0 on every row.

Fields.Name: Unknown
Fields.Description: Appears unused by the game. Retail 0 on every row.

Fields.Name: Extra Boss Attach Point
Fields.Description: SmallBaseAndSpotAttachPoint row used when the map pattern has an extra boss and this is the Day 1 area.
